dataset: Traffic volumes on CNV municipal streets
organizations_searched: BC MoTI Traffic Data Program; CNV; DNV GEOweb; TransLink; Metro Vancouver; BC Data Catalogue
what_was_found: BC program covers provincial highways only; 10 CNV stations all Short Core on Hwy 1 with latest counts 2016; CNV publishes directional volumes for only 38 of 941 segments
why_unavailable: Province does not count municipal streets; CNV holds counts internally and releases on request
best_proxy_used: Road classification (70%) plus sparse published volumes (30%)
coverage_achieved: 40 of 503 intersections have a measured volume
limitations: traffic_score is primarily a road-hierarchy ranking not a measured traffic ranking

dataset: Traffic signal cycle and phase timing
organizations_searched: CNV engineering and transportation pages; CNV ArcGIS; council reports
what_was_found: Signals GIS layer is asset inventory only; CNV Level 1 Transportation Study Guidelines p.6 states phasing and cycle lengths are provided by the City on request
why_unavailable: Held internally and released on request; never published
limitations: No claim about wait time or longest light is supportable
recommended_next_action: Request from eng@cnv.org or measure in field

organizations_searched: CNV transportation planning; Walk CNV; council reports; TransLink; Metro Vancouver
what_was_found: Walk CNV 2017 is a perception survey with no counts; only published count is Moodyville 2016 Fig 43 (2015 data raster in PDF one corridor); North Shore Transportation Survey is city-wide modelled only
limitations: Proxy is never presented as a count; counts and proxies held in separate fields

organizations_searched: CNV; CivicInfo BC; Elections BC; CNV election bylaws
what_was_found: Nothing found; CNV runs any-voting-place elections so no catchments exist
why_unavailable: Structurally absent from CNV electoral model
best_proxy_used: Voting-place points plus 400/800/1600 m context buffers
limitations: Votes at a place cannot be attributed to nearby residents

what_was_found: 2011/2014/2018 sheets have a TOTAL VOTERS row; the 2022 sheet does not
best_proxy_used: Mayoral votes per place as a lower bound
limitations: 41325 x 22.64% is arithmetic not official; unverifiable third-party figure not used
recommended_next_action: Request from the CNV Chief Election Officer

why_unavailable: Not published below municipality; privacy sensitive
limitations: Neither is an elector count; term eligible voters is never used and is blocked by a test

what_was_found: Observed survey only: 1169 segments across 8 periods by Bunt & Associates Dec 2022 and Jan/Feb 2023
best_proxy_used: The survey itself with survey_period recorded
limitations: Reflects the survey window only; never presented as live

dataset: Building height unit counts and year built
what_was_found: Footprint layer carries only status and name; only the High Rise >18m layer carries height/units/year (107 records)
why_unavailable: City does not publish attributes for general footprints
best_proxy_used: Census dwelling structure type at DA level
limitations: UNKNOWN means nothing is published - not that a building is non-residential
recommended_next_action: Request the building attribute table from CNV

what_was_found: Occupancy attribute explicitly contains STRATA for some buildings
why_unavailable: Only published for the high-rise layer
best_proxy_used: City STRATA attribute only - never inferred from form
limitations: Tenure elsewhere recorded as unknown not assumed
recommended_next_action: Request strata records from BC Assessment

dataset: Licensed seniors care facilities in CNV
organizations_searched: VCH; BC Housing; Office of the Seniors Advocate; BC Data Catalogue; CNV
what_was_found: Provincial registries show zero licensed LTC/AL inside the City; Evergreen House (231 E 15th St 284 beds) IS in the City but is licensed under the Hospital Act so is absent from both registries
why_unavailable: Registry scope excludes Hospital Act facilities
best_proxy_used: 11 seniors-eligible affordable-housing sites from City 55+ eligibility
limitations: Subsidised independent housing is not licensed care; Sunrise at Lonsdale Square and Summerhill PARC unresolved
recommended_next_action: Confirm Evergreen House and Sunrise with Vancouver Coastal Health

what_was_found: Tableau CSV export gives location name strings with no coordinates; NORTH VANCOUVER covers both City and District
why_unavailable: ICBC publishes no coordinates and no bulk open-data file
best_proxy_used: Conservative street-pair name matching against the CNV intersection layer
limitations: Unmatched intersections are unknown not zero; counts are not year-specific

dataset: Municipal land area vs legal boundary
what_was_found: ABMS legal boundary is 14.92 km2 including foreshore; StatCan land area is 11.83 km2
best_proxy_used: StatCan land area used for all densities
limitations: Legal boundary used only for clipping and display
